reasoning: Shows a cloud outline containing an exclamation mark, universally understood in software as a cloud sync error, storage full warning, or service outage (and secondarily a severe weather alert). It fits tasks specifically about fixing broken backups, resolving sync conflicts, freeing up full cloud storage, or handling server alarms, though at tiny sizes the exclamation mark can resemble a download arrow.
